findings.location: <div class="poem"> — stanza 2, line 2 (second stanza, second line)
findings.source_quote: Straight or crooked, one of twain;
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust for natural agreement/clarity in Portuguese while preserving meaning. Two acceptable fixes: keep as-is or make agreement explicit, e.g. replace "Reta ou tortuosa, uma das duas;" with "Reto ou tortuoso, um dos dois;" or with "Reta ou tortuosa, uma das duas;" if keeping feminine agreement with "vida"/"caminho." Either is acceptable; no doctrinal change.
findings.translation_quote: Reta ou tortuosa, uma das duas;
